text: The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated; the status of two clients is unknown. Migrating twelve known clients is substantial progress. The broader pro-action interpretation is that the evidence supports continued migration work; more precisely, it does not support removing the aliases. Note the bounded contrast: integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients but not the two clients of unknown status, a limit on the broader action rather than on the positive evaluation. Do not remove the aliases until the two remaining client owners confirm migration.
